content.text: {"core": "Wisdom holds knowing back until it ripens — sitting with what is not settled instead of forcing it into words. In Abstraction, it works on the pulling-back itself: stepping away from the mess to see the shape underneath. Overdone, the stepping-away never lands — every plain thing gets lifted into a bigger frame, and the frame keeps growing until the actual matter is out of reach.", "sheetLine": "Each thing gets pulled up into a larger picture, and the picture never touches the ground."}
